Death has invited you to play a game of dice, you must use your wits to figure out if you or he have earned greater favor with Lady Luck. Face a gauntlet of his demons and use your special powers to try and get the upper hand. But be careful, knowledge always comes at a price
column13: Alex Rose has been working on Games since college, he worked for the Texas A&M Live lab as a game designer and at TYM studios as a software developer after that. He's always loved being in the game development community, he helped run the Texas A&M Game Developers club. Dead Men Don't Die is his studio's first foray into independent game development.

column6: Forbidden Sight is an action-adventure stealth game where you play as a thief infiltrating the Human Archive Museum, a massive facility where an alien civilization preserves humanity as part of its collection. Sneak past alien security, steal advanced technology, and solve puzzles using an experimental light gun. Fire light projectiles to illuminate the darkness and leave glowing trails to navigate the museum, or unleash powerful gamma shots to damage enemies and erase your trails. Journey backward through human history, from futuristic sci-fi exhibits to prehistoric civilizations, and survive what awakens in the dark.
column13: Refraction Studios started in early 2026 as a team from UT Austin’s 3D Game Development Capstone Course. What began as a semester-long project with structured development sprints and showcases quickly grew into something we wanted to pursue beyond the classroom. We continued developing Forbidden Sight over the summer while sharing the game at showcases and events, before regrouping this fall with an expanded team and new members filling key roles. We're excited to continue growing the project and are currently aiming for a release in late spring 2027.
